lessons.title: Let’s Talk About Plans

items.exampleMeaning: I am going to the cinema.
What day is the meeting?

items.example: El próximo lunes tengo una cita.
items.exampleMeaning: Next Monday I have an appointment.

items.example: El fin de semana voy a descansar.
items.exampleMeaning: This weekend I am going to rest.
Would you like to go to the park?
It's okay, let's go together.

lessons.tip: Use 'voy a' to express plans you will do in the future. Remember to use the correct day and time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What day are we going to the cinema?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Voy a ir el próximo sábado.
dialogue.meaning: I am going next Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Okay. What time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: A las cinco de la tarde.
dialogue.meaning: At five in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Would you like to eat something before?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, me gustaría comer una pizza.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would like to eat a pizza.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend making plans with you
scenario.brief: You are talking about going to the cinema. Ask about the day and time. Confirm your plans.
scenario.goal: You need to confirm the day and time for the cinema.

lessons.title: Inviting Friends

items.exampleMeaning: I invite you to my party.
Do you want to come to my house?

items.example: Sería genial vernos este fin de semana.
items.exampleMeaning: It would be great to see each other this weekend.
What do you think of the idea?

items.example: Me encantaría ir a la fiesta.
items.exampleMeaning: I would love to go to the party.
I'm sorry, I can't go.

lessons.tip: When inviting someone, use 'te invito a' to make it clear you are inviting them. Be ready for a positive or negative response.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Te invito a mi fiesta el viernes.
dialogue.meaning: I invite you to my party on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you! Do you want me to bring something?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: No, just come. Do you want to come?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would love to.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: It would be great to see you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I'm sorry, I can't go.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend inviting you to a party
scenario.brief: You are inviting a friend to your party. Ask if they want to bring something and confirm their attendance.
scenario.goal: You need to invite your friend and get their response.

lessons.title: Making Future Plans

items.exampleMeaning: We are going out tomorrow.
On Tuesday I have a meeting.

items.example: ¿A qué hora nos encontramos el sábado?
items.exampleMeaning: What time do we meet on Saturday?
I can at six.

items.meaning: Does that sound good to you?
items.exampleMeaning: Does Tuesday sound good to you?

items.example: Lo siento, estoy ocupado el miércoles.
items.exampleMeaning: I'm sorry, I am busy on Wednesday.

lessons.tip: Use 'vamos a' to talk about plans you will do together. Be clear about the day and time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: We are going out tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: What time do we meet?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Does seven sound good to you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Puedo a las siete, pero estoy ocupado a las ocho.
dialogue.meaning: I can at seven, but I am busy at eight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Está bien, nos vemos a las siete.
dialogue.meaning: Okay, we will see each other at seven.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Perfect, see you.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend making plans with you
scenario.learnerRole: someone confirming the time and day
scenario.brief: You are making plans to go out with a friend. Discuss the time and confirm if it works for you.
scenario.goal: You need to confirm the time and day for going out.

lessons.title: Confirming Plans

items.exampleMeaning: Yes, of course, I will go with you.
Is it confirmed for Friday?
The time sounds good to me.

items.example: No estoy seguro si puedo ir.
items.exampleMeaning: I am not sure if I can go.

items.example: Tal vez puedo ir el sábado.
items.exampleMeaning: Maybe I can go on Saturday.
I will let you know if I can go.

lessons.tip: Use 'sí, claro' to confirm plans. If you're unsure, say 'no estoy seguro/a' or 'tal vez'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Is it confirmed for Friday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course, I am ready.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: The time sounds good to me.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tal vez puedo ir más tarde.
dialogue.meaning: Maybe I can go later.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No estoy seguro si puedo ir.
dialogue.meaning: I am not sure if I can go.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I will let you know if I can.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend confirming plans with you
scenario.brief: You are confirming plans with a friend. Ask if everything is set and respond to their questions.
scenario.goal: You need to confirm the plans and share your availability.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What day are we going to the cinema?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Voy a ir el próximo sábado.
dialogue.meaning: I am going next Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Te invito a mi fiesta el viernes.
dialogue.meaning: I invite you to my party on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would love to.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Vamos a salir mañana. ¿A qué hora?
dialogue.meaning: We are going out tomorrow. What time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Puedo a las seis, pero estoy ocupado a las ocho.
dialogue.meaning: I can at six, but I am busy at eight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Is it confirmed for Friday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, claro, te aviso si hay un cambio.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, of course, I will let you know if there is a change.

scenario.partnerRole: a friend reviewing plans with you
scenario.brief: You are discussing plans for going out and a party. Confirm the days and times together.
scenario.goal: You need to confirm all the plans discussed.
